title: CI coverage gates and test documentation
summary: Make the complete suite repeatable in CI with enforceable coverage and contributor guidance.
description: Wire package and root scripts for unit, integration, coverage, and Playwright runs. Publish package-level coverage reports and enforce agreed thresholds for source code while excluding generated assets and unavoidable bootstrap wrappers. Add CI services/setup for Node 25, browsers, temporary ports, and deterministic test data; make failures retain useful Playwright traces and coverage artifacts. Document how to run all suites, how to add a scenario to the shared matrix, how Pi host fakes work, how MCP transports are selected, and how to diagnose flaky filesystem/WebSocket/browser tests. Keep publication workflows separate from test execution and do not alter release behavior.

tasks.title: Wire package and root test scripts with coverage gates
tasks.description: Add consistent package scripts for unit, integration, coverage, and E2E suites, plus root orchestration commands that run the complete matrix in dependency order. Enforce package-level statement/line/function thresholds and branch thresholds agreed during baseline, exclude generated bundles only, and emit CI-readable summaries plus HTML/JSON artifacts. Ensure failures stop the pipeline and local commands remain usable without CI-only services.

tasks.title: Add CI workflow for browsers integration services and reports
tasks.description: Extend CI for Node 25, dependency installation, TypeScript checks, package tests, coverage collection, Playwright browser installation, real server/MCP/Pi integration fixtures, and artifact upload on failure. Keep publication workflow separate, use isolated temporary directories and dynamic ports, and make browser traces/screenshots/coverage available for diagnosis without leaking project data or secrets.

tasks.title: Document scenario authoring, adapters, fixtures, and troubleshooting
tasks.description: Document how to run each suite, interpret coverage, add shared scenarios, extend API/MCP/Pi runners, use the Pi host boundary, seed browser fixtures, debug WebSocket and dynamic-port failures, and update exclusions or thresholds responsibly. Include the full public-surface inventory workflow and rules for never touching real user `.planner` directories in tests.

tasks.title: Harden deterministic cleanup and flaky-test diagnostics
tasks.description: Audit all new suites for leaked timers, ports, WebSocket listeners, child processes, browser contexts, temporary directories, and stale generated files. Add retries only where justified, failure diagnostics with scenario IDs and snapshots, deterministic clocks/IDs where needed, and a quarantine policy for genuinely environment-dependent Pi CLI smoke checks. Confirm repeated local and CI runs produce stable results without mutating repository planner state.
